professionalSummary.text: Senior data engineer with 18 months of experience building and maintaining nightly loaders for Visa and Mastercard settlement files and general ledger extracts into a Snowflake-based reconciliation warehouse.
professionalSummary.witness: Built the nightly loader that ingests Visa and Mastercard settlement files (TC57/T112) and the general-ledger extract into the reconciliation warehouse on Snowflake, using dbt models and a Python pre-validation step for file checksums.

professionalSummary.text: Expertise in investigating unmatched settlement items, collaborating with finance operations analysts to trace exceptions and document root causes in an exception log.
professionalSummary.witness: Worked the daily unmatched-item queue with two finance operations analysts, tracing each exception to fee mismatches, timing differences or duplicate captures, and recorded the root cause and resolution in the shared exception log.

professionalSummary.text: Proven ability to reduce unmatched-item backlog, reporting a 35% decrease during tenure.
professionalSummary.witness: candidate said the unmatched backlog 'came down by around 35 percent' while he was on the team and that the finance director was pleased; he did not have the monthly report to hand and could not say what the starting figure was.

professionalSummary.text: Experience presenting pipeline changes during monthly change-window reviews with settlement operations and compliance teams, coordinating responsibilities and go-live approvals.
professionalSummary.witness: Presented pipeline changes at the monthly change-window review with settlement operations and compliance; my part covered the loader and the matching keys, while approval of the go-live date stayed with the finance engineering lead.

professionalSummary.text: Documented data lineage, known limitations, and hand-over conditions for each pipeline release.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the lineage notes for the matching model, listing the source files, the transformation steps and the two known limitations (partial refunds and multi-currency fees) that still needed manual review.
